title: Bahar Bistar Neeche Tak
human_truth: Some couples do not cancel the plan; they resize it until both moods fit.
emotional_arc: outside desire vs rest mode -> tiny negotiation -> half-ready proof -> smaller outing -> raw Hinglish payoff
slide_summaries: She is ready at the door while he is buried in bed.
His whole body votes for bistar.
He starts bargaining from inside the blanket.
The plan shrinks to downstairs only.
One shoe/slipper proof shows he is trying.
The payoff lands: neeche tak counts.
